caption:
Are Mounjaro and Zepbound the same drug?

Mounjaro and Zepbound both contain tirzepatide. Mounjaro is approved for type 2 diabetes and Zepbound for weight management. Did you know this? Yes or no.

More at pepsafe.info/p/tirzepatide.html
